name: Hito de Naku, Hitodenashi
original_name: ひとでなく、ひとでなし
source: A world with humans and fantasy monsters who are often in conflict with each other. The protagonist is a drider / spider-centaur girl named Sugar.
translation: A world with humans and fantasy monsters who are often in conflict with each other. The protagonist is a drider / spider-centaur girl named Sugar.
